claims.claim_text: The scene was secured for investigation.
claims.evidence_observations: The segments capture officers discussing a perimeter. One asks 'we got a perimeter do we got enough,' another asks for someone to check 'no one on the uh left side' and for the south side to be advised, and a third reports 'we got straight line sight' and says 'I just want to Perimeter right now we keep them in there.' This indicates a perimeter was being set up or was in progress, with officers still asking whether they had enough personnel and checking coverage. The segments do not show the scene being fully secured, and nothing addresses the 'for investigation' element of the claim. The evidence is consistent with a perimeter forming but does not directly confirm the scene was secured.

claims.claim_text: The business owner was contacted regarding damage and recovered property.
claims.evidence_observations: The only transcript segment (0:02-0:03) is a garbled radio exchange in which an officer or dispatcher asks whether 'Advanced Marine Service' covers a back door entry motion (apparently an alarm). The segment does not mention contacting the business owner, property damage, or recovered property. It bears on a possible alarm activation at the premises but does not directly address either part of the claim. Later segments, if any, were not provided.
